evidence.input_source: Exact wire.user.original_context and original_account_spans for each call; not a reconstructed account

method: Independent read of all six actual candidate objects, exact full attributed inputs and predeclared oracle. No model reviewer verdict was used as ground truth; no new inference or search was run.
decision: Do not promote the research-only routing change on these six cases. Preserve useful discovery concepts and isolate deterministic source/query assembly from routing. Do not turn exploratory legal terminology into a false-fact rejection merely because the advocate did not supply that term.

count_interpretation.what_that_count_means: One candidate met all combined intended conditions, including focused account selection and absence of semantic/relevance concerns, in six selected regression inputs.
what_it_does_not_mean: Not five proven false legal answers out of six; no legal answer was delivered or evaluated here.
Not five clearly invalid sets of legal discovery hypotheses; several concerns are account noise, ambiguity or unmeasured relevance.
Not a held-out accuracy or false-positive rate; these six were known selected regressions.
Not retrieval failure or success; no candidate corpus retrieval or reranking was measured in this run.
count_interpretation.independent_definite_failure_scope: A changed explicitly assumed factual premise in the agency comparison, and renewed legal work despite the social close. This conservative count does not certify the other four as fully acceptable.

cases.name: original_aster_held_drive
cases.assessment: Both requested legal disputes retained; plausible discovery with account-selection noise and relationship-targeting risks. Do not classify every unprovided legal term as fabricated fact.

output.exact_output: Contractual obligations and rights under equipment hire agreements

supported_discovery.reason: Equipment-hire contractual rights are a directly connected legal investigation.

output.exact_output: Requirements for evidence and documentation to validate damage claims

source.speaker: advocate
source.text: The owner sent a technician's estimate but no joint inspection report.

supported_discovery.reason: Checking evidential sufficiency of estimate/report material is useful. This particular output does not assert that no report or inspection exists.

output.exact_output: Possession and lien rights over client's property used in rented equipment setup

source.speaker: advocate
source.text: the owner's technician still has our client's original design drive, which the client says was lent only for setup; the owner now says it can retain the drive until repair costs are paid.

supported_discovery.reason: Lien and possession are legitimate candidate legal concepts for asserted retention pending repair costs. Their prerequisites are not thereby established.

output.exact_output: Legal remedies to recover property and challenging unlawful retention

supported_discovery.reason: A remedies search involving unlawful retention is a conditional legal route, not by itself an assertion that this retention has been adjudged unlawful.

output.exact_output: Tenant's rights and procedures concerning security deposit retention

scope_or_relevance_risks.reason: Tenant terminology may draw immovable-property material into equipment hire. Treat as a relevance concern to inspect in actual results, not automatic proof that the planner found the wrong law.

output.exact_output: Legal rights and obligations related to retention of client's original design drive by equipment owner

scope_or_relevance_risks.reason: The title compresses technician possession and owner-asserted retention into owner retention. Preserve both roles downstream. Because the owner asserts the retention claim, this title alone is not conclusive proof of a changed material actor for discovery.

cases.input_noise: Both investigations select the whole mixed message plus contained ranges and task restrictions. Exactness is preserved, but factual focus and token efficiency are not. This should not itself become a semantic false-fact gate.

cases.name: greeting_social_close
cases.assessment: Definite current-work routing failure, independent of the quality of the tenancy concepts.

output.exact_output: Legal investigation on rent review and tenancy papers requirements

latest_source.speaker: advocate
latest_source.text: Thanks, this is enough for today. Good night.

earlier_source.speaker: advocate
earlier_source.text: When I return with the tenancy papers, we can look at the rent demand.

definite_error.mismatch: The earlier work was conditional on returning with papers; the latest message closes the conversation. The candidate renews that work and emits three searches. Automatically attaching latest as trigger proves input ownership, not current authorisation or necessity.

owning_boundary_recommendation.owner: nm/core_engine/research.py, at checked source-to-query construction and versioned search-contract validation; do not mix in research-only routing promotion.
owning_boundary_recommendation.independently_isolatable: Yes, an exact original-account/context recall query before existing admitted legal enquiries can be tested independently of replacing the planner with a research-only router. Gate that mechanical prefix on existing planned search work, not merely on the presence of source words. This retains existing routing behavior and its known limitations; it does not solve routing.
minimal_mechanics: Resolve only server-owned original-account source selections. Preserve coordinates, speaker and exact text. Do not turn NM-derived rows into factual recall.
Prefix the selected exact original words once, before up to three declared legal-concept/enquiry queries. Keep their source identities and boundaries; no paraphrasing or invented connecting facts.

Remove duplicate/contained copies only within the same source using exact coordinates in query presentation; preserve the full canonical source selections and proof. Do not merge equal words from different sources or offsets.
Use a versioned new-query contract so existing v2 saved query order/context/rendering is reproduced unchanged.
A max-three schema is a resource/shape invariant, not semantic ranking. Do not silently choose the first three from four or claim that three are distinct/relevant merely because the count fits.
Do not adopt the candidate code-attached latest trigger as proof of current legal-work permission. Keep routing assessment a separate semantic responsibility.
owning_boundary_recommendation.observable_pass: For an already admitted current legal work item, the saved request to both lexical/vector legs begins with exact owned original words, followed by all admitted queries within the cap; query IDs, ordering, provenance and receipt remain stable on replay. No-search work produces no query. New construction changes neither matter facts nor requested deliverables.
consequential_counterexamples: A social/no-law turn gets account search merely because historical facts exist.
An unknown or derived source becomes factual recall; a quote at one offset silently resolves to another identical occurrence.
A fourth enquiry is silently discarded or old v2 replay silently receives the new prefix/cap.
A plausible legal hypothesis is treated as an established matter fact, or a gate rejects it solely because the advocate did not name its terminology.
owning_boundary_recommendation.semantic_measurement_needed: Inspect retrieved results and final supported use before claiming relevance or legal accuracy. Evaluate factual-scope changes separately from alternative legal hypotheses and presentation noise. The prefix may recover candidates but cannot make an altered concept premise safe or decide current research need.
owning_boundary_recommendation.model_calls: No additional routine model stage for deterministic source/query assembly. Existing four routine stages remain; any correction still uses the turn-owned existing bound.
